_readme: Probe set: how a reader might DESCRIBE a theorem without knowing its name. Written by imagining the question rather than by collecting reported failures, so it samples the space instead of the complaints. Deliberately harder than eval-queries.json and kept separate: eval-queries.json is the regression gate, this is the exploration set. Each case is [query, [acceptable ids]]. Re-check labels before trusting a miss; several 'failures' here turned out to be wrong labels where search returned the better card.
